notes.title: Re-Build
notes.content:
Thank you for waiting for a long time.
I made a large-scale rebuild with feedback from the user.
There are many changes, the typical changes are as follows.

1. Story
- The intro has been changed.
- You can continue the whole story to the end.

2. Dungeon
  - The dungeon is not on the 100th floor.
  - The dungeon is not a roguelike anymore.
  - The composition of the dungeon is five. 
    (Prison, Forest, Ruins, City, Hell)
  - The dungeon has a torch installed by default.
  - Resources and minerals become rare.
  - Install items will not be saved anymore.
  - The baguettes should be removed with a hammer.
  - Use a weapon to attack the baguette and damage its durability.

3. Monster
  - A special red monster appears in each room.
  - When you kill a special monster, monster power will Increase
  - reinforced monsters have increased experience, gold and drop probability.

4. Character
  - Wall climbing.
  - For platforms that can pass through, it is also possible to come down
    to the bottom.
  - If you are attacked by a trap and monsters, the character will be Knockback.

5. Controls
  - Most games are now available using only the keyboard.
  - But, the inventory and combination still need a mouse.

6. Etc
  - The character information is initialized as a rebuild.
  - I sincerely apologize to those who have developed
     the character with an affection.

notes.title: Development journal
notes.content:
I would like to thank the users who are waiting for the update of Lonia Saga 2
I will share some details about the schedule and updates in the future.

1. Dungeon structure
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32947995/4500cce0c17c21358ad55a63992693a06f63e096.gif[/img]
Lonia Saga will not borrow any more log-like schemes (random maps).
Rather than a dungeon configuration that does not know how to proceed in a random fashion,
The purpose of this exercise is to ensure that the user will experience
This is the state you have set. As a result, the structure of the dungeon will become more detailed from the implementation method, and various objects will provide more visual experience than ever before.

2. Zones And Camera system
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32947995/3192e70ddc11f9987ca24b9bdf1569e2484fa4d8.gif[/img]

Dungeons are no longer simply a way to look for maps in the form of 1 to 100 stories. Traps that are less than the existing stage, traps, combat battlefields will be separated for a definite purpose, and each time you move through each zone, the screen will automatically switch to match the zone. At this time, the monsters will be reset by interval.


3. Wall jump
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32947995/ddf48a94c66525a04b6e32b830bf8d090b502f79.gif[/img]

The wall jump function will be added to make it easier to explore the dungeon without the help of items such as a box or rope by modifying the way of installing a lot of items in the past.

4. Detailed Dungeons
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32947995/d8456e99f691bece3fae2922b74314fd07b807e6.gif[/img]
The character of the platform game is stronger than the method of installing the existing item. You must attack the dungeon by jumping and avoiding more pitfalls than installing various objects. However, you still have to install objects to unlock the various puzzles and reach the cloaked area in a certain section.

5. Knockback
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32947995/c057e087afd95bc9291e3e595ffb2fa3b6c802e7.gif[/img]
Knockback effect is added to the battle with the existing plain monster. This will make the battle with the monsters more difficult.

6. Update Schedule
As the development direction of the game is revised as a whole, more work is going on, which will require more months of work. I will return with much better quality that you have been waiting for a long time. Thank you.
